newsitem.title: USA: Smith Barney sees cold in U.S. Northeast next week.
newsitem.headline: Smith Barney sees cold in U.S. Northeast next week.

text.p: Smith Barney meteorologist Jon Davis said he expects temperatures in the northeastern United States to be 10 to 14 degrees below normal late next week and through next weekend.
"Basically there is going to be another artic outbreak for the nation next week, from the Rockies eastward," said Davis.
Davis has forecasted temperatures to be below normal in the Northeast this weekend, but he said temperatures could normalize early next week before cooling again.
The Midwest next week will once again experience temperatures that are 15 to 20 degrees below normal, Davis said.
"It's the same cold air mass," he said.
Davis said an artic air mass has been building in Siberia and the North Pole since mid-November, and parts of it have been creeping into the United States, causing the below normal temperatures.
